title: CTRL: HIP HOP · Friday Dec 4 · Springfield
seo_title: CTRL: Hip Hop Night at CTRL Nightclub, Springfield MO
description: CTRL: Hip Hop is a Friday night of trap and rap at CTRL Nightclub, with classics and new tracks. The summary lists the audience as 21+, though the club says 18+ may enter and 21+ may drink, and a valid photo ID is required; there is no cover before 11 PM for ages 21+, and tickets start from USD 16. It runs Friday, December 4, 2026 from 9:00 PM (doors) until 1:30 AM at 311 S Patton Ave, Springfield, MO, and buying a ticket ahead is recommended since a 21+ ticket guarantees entry after 11 PM through the VIP Fast Pass lane.
